about_the_game:
A Lounge Somewhere is an open-world exploration RPG. You are an ordinary person who unintentionally discovered a seemingly ordinary lounge. Here, you can drink coffee, enjoy snacks, grow flowers, play Gashapons, play the piano, try arcade games, and play various games with the server... No task is mandatory to complete. Everything here is designed to make you feel at home.

  • Free Exploration

The lounge spans three floors, equipped with various usable facilities and items. You are free to do anything: enjoy coffee and cake at the bar, try making different types of coffee yourself, bake some cookies in the oven, freely adjust the lighting and curtains, change into your favorite pajamas, lie down or nap on the bed, plant your favorite flowers in the planter, or play your favorite music on the piano...

 

  • Focused Work

Using the computer in the lounge, you can freely set up and activate a unique focus mode. Once engaged, the game will block all distractions for you—except for allowing the server to bring you coffee or snacks. This helps you quickly enter a state of single-minded, highly efficient work.

 

  • Silence is Golden

To spend money in this lounge, you need to use a mysterious currency called "Silence Coins." This doesn't seem to be any real-world currency... However, as long as you're inside the lounge, something that can be exchanged for Silence Coins will continuously and silently grow in your pocket—meaning you'll never have to worry about financial pressure.

 

  • Real-World Time

The time here runs parallel with the real world. When night falls in reality, the view outside the lounge's windows will also be tinged with dusk, bringing you an immersive sense of realism.

 

  • Weather Changes

The weather here is unpredictable and completely different from reality! One moment it might be sunny, and the next, strong winds might howl, rain might pour, or gentle snowflakes might fall. But don't worry, you can check the weather forecast on the lounge's TV to anticipate the weather trends for the next 24 hours and calmly respond to any unexpected environmental changes.

 

  • Nostalgic Arcade

Tucked away in a corner of the lounge is a retro arcade machine filled with nostalgia. Here, you can freely play a series of classic built-in mini-games: challenge the limits of Snake, experience the thrill of Breakout, feel the excitement of Space Invaders, relive the joy of Tetris... You can even try drawing and composing.

 

  • A server on duty 24/7

Whether you want to purchase ready-made drinks and snacks or wish to engage in a board game or word game, the server here will always be on standby, professional and thoughtful, adjusting the difficulty to your skill level. Striking up a conversation with the server at different times and under various weather conditions might even trigger unexpected responses.

 

  • Smooth Gameplay Experience

Auto Save – Seamlessly save your game progress!
Screen Adaptation – Full-screen display on devices with various aspect ratios!

 

  • More content

More content is currently under construction, please stay tuned!
